dedupeText: eighties urban night portrait 1980s aesthetic big hair oversized blazer neon lighting urban night script lettering teal and orange contrast between the cool blue ambient light and the warm yellow background glow the diagonal line of the woman s gaze meeting the diagonal orientation of the text the textural contrast between the soft frizzy hair and the structured fabric of the blazer the teal shirt acting as a bridge between the blue shadows and the subject s skin tones combine 80s urban night photography with oversized fashion and slanted monolinear script to create a nostalgic music themed visual

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a woman with voluminous dark hair wearing an oversized dark blazer over a teal shirt, set against a blurred urban night background with cool blue shadows and warm yellow highlights. The composition features a prominent, slanted script logo in the upper right corner.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the cool blue ambient light and the warm yellow background glow
The diagonal line of the woman's gaze meeting the diagonal orientation of the text
The textural contrast between the soft, frizzy hair and the structured fabric of the blazer
The teal shirt acting as a bridge between the blue shadows and the subject's skin tones
coreInvariants: Teal/Cyan pop of color near the face
Blue-toned night photography with cinematic grain

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered-left, occupying roughly two-thirds of the frame vertically and horizontally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and eyes, highlighted by warm directional lighting.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's eyes, moves down the line of the blazer, then sweeps up to the script logo in the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, shadowy areas in the lower left and upper left provide breathing room for the subject's hair and the text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep navy and cool blue tones in the shadows and blazer.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm amber and yellow lights in the background.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant teal/seafoam green on the shirt collar.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between dark shadows and bright highlights; mid-tones are saturated in the teal and skin areas.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid modern flat colors; use film-like gradients and grain.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Cursive script with a slight upward slant.
letterConstructionRules: Underlining flourish that extends from the final letter back towards the start
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'F' features a wide, sweeping top bar
The 'i' dot is integrated closely with the stem
The terminal 'e' flows into a long, sharp underline

treatment.outline: Thin dark drop shadow for legibility

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single dominant script; any secondary info should be in a clean, small sans-serif.

avoid: Modern geometric sans-serifs for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the casual, hand-drawn energy of the era.
Matches the urban night aesthetic and monolinear stroke.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A cinematic 1980s night portrait of a woman with very large, frizzy dark hair wearing a dark oversized blazer and a teal collar. Background is a blurred city street with blue shadows and warm yellow streetlights. High grain, film photography style.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, white, hand-drawn monolinear script title in the top right corner, slanted upwards at 15 degrees, with a long underline flourish extending from the last letter.

verificationChecks: Is the hair volume sufficiently large for an 80s aesthetic?
Does the teal shirt pop against the dark blazer?
Is the script title slanted upwards?
Is there a clear contrast between blue and yellow lighting?

mustRedesign: Flat lighting (must have high-contrast night lighting)
postGenerationChecks: Check for the presence of the teal collar accent.
Ensure the script text has a monolinear, hand-drawn feel.
Verify the subject has the characteristic 80s 'big hair' texture.
Confirm the background lighting uses a blue/yellow complementary scheme.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [80s urban night photography] with [oversized fashion] and [slanted monolinear script] to create a nostalgic music-themed visual.
